For the fine-tuning methods, the hyper-parameters are set by grid search. Specifically, we set learning rate in $(5e - 4, 1e - 4, 5e - 5, 1e - 5, 5e - 6, 1e - 6)$ , learning steps in [5, 25] with early stopping at loss $= 0.1$ . For the coefficients of SIDE, we conduct a grid search on the training dataset and empirically set them as $\lambda = 0.6$ , $\alpha = 0.8$ , $\beta = 0.1$ , $\gamma = 0.1$ .

All experiments in this paper can be undertaken on two Nvidia A100 80G GPU. Each evaluation run takes $0.5 \sim 1$ hours. We conduct about 500 evaluation runs in total.
